milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the smoker and face it to demonstrate they have found it. The target is the outdoor smoker at spawn-relative (0, 0, 4), which is the primary and most visible smoker in the scene (~4 blocks from spawn under an oak awning). max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the smoker. The indoor smoker at (5, 1, 5) is also within range if the player enters the oak building, so this single rule covers both smokers effectively.

scene_description: A small village scene with two buildings (oak planks and spruce planks) and an outdoor cooking station. An outdoor smoker is placed under a small awning approximately 4 blocks from spawn, clearly visible from the spawn point. A second smoker is inside the oak building for added realism. The player must locate the smoker block by navigating the village.
task_text: Find the smoker block in the village. Look around and walk toward it.
design_notes: The outdoor smoker at ~0 ~0 ~4 is the primary target — only 4 blocks from spawn, under a small awning (oak fence + oak slabs), clearly visible from the spawn point. A second smoker inside the oak building at ~5 ~1 ~5 adds realism. The spruce building at ~-6 to ~-3, ~-4 to ~-7 provides visual variety. Both buildings have 2-block-wide doorways for easy entry. The cobblestone spawn pad and paths connect the structures.
